subject: Whole team in the studio after Holi, colour on faces, arms up
notes: Posed group shot, kept because it is the only high-res studio frame and it is real. Culture only: About/careers banner or a team figure; not for service pages. Faces cluster in the middle band, keep 0.3-0.6 vertical in any crop.

subject: Studio whiteboard sorted into Research / Strategy-UX / Visual-UI-Design columns of sticky notes, a hand adding one
notes: Strongest studio work shot. Portrait 922px wide: fine up to ~460 CSS px at 2x. Column headings are handwritten board labels, not overlay type.

subject: Team session in the studio lounge, one person speaking to the group seated around
notes: Shows the studio room and its colour-grid shelving. 946px: card or half-column only.

subject: Two designers at one monitor, one leaning in over the other's shoulder
notes: Exactly the ch05 two-people-at-one-screen brief. Near-square, 622px: card size only.

subject: Design crit: three seated, one presenting at a wall of whiteboard diagrams
notes: Boards mid-argument. Diagrams are illegible at size. 898px: card only.

subject: Three team members standing and talking in a heritage room at an offsite
notes: Warm tungsten cast; pairs well with paper-deep grounds. Weakest of the studio set; use as a supporting card.

subject: Two designers at adjacent desks turned to each other mid-conversation, open studio behind
notes: Good studio context with the room legible. 622px: card only.

subject: Two designers presenting at a projected screen in a workshop
notes: Projected slide is a Tcules workshop, illegible at card size. 622px: card only.

subject: Team member headshot, glasses, laughing, light grey ground
notes: Delivered pre-masked as a circle with transparent corners (alpha kept). 292px: max 140 CSS px at 2x. Render in a circular frame; a square frame will show the transparent corners.

subject: Team member headshot, white shirt, smiling, light grey ground
notes: Pre-masked circle, alpha kept. 292px: max 140 CSS px at 2x.

subject: Team member headshot in front of a weathered blue door
notes: Pre-masked circle, alpha kept. 292px: max 140 CSS px at 2x. Blue door ground echoes brandeis without being it.

subject: Designer pinning and sketching on a long wall of printouts in a bright corridor
notes: Tall portrait; works as the tall image beside a hero title.

subject: Two hands with markers drawing a flow on a whiteboard, close crop
notes: Mostly white; reads as calm negative space with a figure in it. Handwriting is illegible at size.

subject: Two people at a whiteboard of sketches, one holding a laptop
notes: Two people in conversation at a board, no pointing, no eye contact.

subject: Designer arranging a wall of printed wireframes
notes: Subject sits right; room on the left for a cropped banner.

subject: Hand drawing a mobile wireframe on paper, warm dark desk
notes: Best sketch close-up; dupes of the same series were rejected.

subject: Top-down desk: wireframe sketch pad, sticky notes, keyboard, tea
notes: Flat-lay on dark ground; strong at banner width.

subject: Designer at a monitor showing a half-built product UI
notes: Screen UI is generic; not legible at card size.

subject: A whole wall of hundreds of coloured sticky notes
notes: Pure texture-like detail; use small, it is loud at banner size.

subject: Dense wall of handwritten sticky notes in warm colours
notes: Alternative to sticky-notes-mass with a warmer palette.

subject: Twelve yellow sticky notes in a neat grid on a pale wall
notes: Lots of negative space; a calm partner to a form or CTA.

subject: Soft-focus wall of sticky notes and pinned cards
notes: Shallow focus makes it a gentle background-weight image beside text (never under it).

subject: Two colleagues at one laptop, sticky notes on the wall behind
notes: Closest stock match to two-people-at-one-screen. 16:9.

subject: Two people at a desk shot through foreground leaves
notes: Leaves on the left act as natural framing; crop from the right side carefully.

subject: Two people talking at a table in front of a chalkboard of sketches
notes: Good for discovery/workshop service content.

subject: Two women reviewing a laptop and notebook at a sunny desk
notes: Bright window light; slightly staged, acceptable.

subject: Blue pencil lying on a sheet of faint wireframes under violet light
notes: Abstract and nearly empty: excellent quiet media. Violet cast sits near brandeis without competing.

subject: Red pencil on a sheet of faint wireframes under warm light
notes: Warm twin of the violet shot; use one per page.

subject: Over-the-shoulder hand sketching a UI on a tablet with a stylus
notes: Striped sleeve in the foreground gives depth.

subject: Designer in a cap sketching on a tablet with a dark monitor beside
notes: Monitor top-left has a legible headline; crop from the right or keep at card size.

subject: Top-down white desk: monitor, phones, wireframe stencils, coffee
notes: A large printed "to" is legible top-right; crop it out or use where incidental text is acceptable.

subject: Designer drawing at a desk in front of a floor-to-ceiling moodboard wall
notes: Studio detail with a lot of texture.

subject: Hand over architectural sketches with markers and a tablet on a wooden table
notes: Portrait detail; good small.

subject: Minimal white desk with monitor in a white room
notes: Very quiet; tall 9:16.

subject: Row of hands writing in notebooks along a long wooden table
notes: Faces out of frame; strong for workshop/training content.

subject: Several hands sorting yellow sticky notes on a blue paper sheet
notes: Affinity mapping in action. Blue paper is not brandeis but reads as blue; keep it off blue-accented blocks.

subject: Small group at a whiteboard in a bright brick-walled room
notes: Tall; room legible around people.

subject: Team on sofas around a whiteboard of sticky notes in a loft studio
notes: Wide room shot; good establishing image.

subject: Overhead-angle team at a wooden table with laptops
notes: Group at work; no eye contact.

subject: Group reviewing a sticky-note board, backs to camera
notes: Backs to camera keeps faces unrecognisable.

subject: Hand on a mouse beside a laptop, colour blur behind
notes: Small detail card.

subject: Hands on a laptop trackpad and keyboard, notebook beside
notes: Tall detail.

subject: Over-the-shoulder view of a design-tool canvas with component frames
notes: Screen content is generic tool chrome; nothing legible that belongs to anyone.

subject: Designer at a home-studio desk with a monitor and phone
notes: Tall 9:16.

subject: Overhead: two people with a phone and laptop, testing a flow
notes: Good for research/testing services.

subject: Hands writing on blue and yellow sticky notes on white
notes: Close detail; white ground helps it sit on paper.

subject: Empty concrete-and-wood studio interior with a long table

subject: Man in a blue shirt, office bokeh behind, slight smile
notes: Shot 2:3, centre-cropped to 1:1.

subject: Man in glasses and dark shirt, arms folded, grey ground
notes: Studio grey ground; slight smile.

subject: Man with curly hair in a green overshirt, looking off camera
notes: Eye line off camera; reads editorial rather than corporate.

subject: Woman in a grey sweater, neutral expression, dark ground
notes: Low-key; pair with a measured quote.

subject: Woman laughing in a blue shirt, dark ground
notes: Most expressive portrait.

subject: Pages of a colour-swatch book fanned on end, chips in ordered columns
notes: A colour library, page by page: tokens as a physical artefact. Left third is soft bokeh; crop from the right. No printed type at any placement size. Added for design-systems fix round 2 (6 Oct 2026).

subject: A heap of identical white building bricks, close and sharp
notes: Unpainted components before they are composed. The moulded stud lettering is unreadable below 2x zoom. Added for design-systems fix round 2 (6 Oct 2026).

subject: Pastel colour sample cards laid in a full ring on a white table, from above
notes: A whole scale laid out in order: the survey before a fix. White ground, no type. Added for design-systems fix round 2 (6 Oct 2026).

subject: Woman smiling outdoors at golden hour, shoulders up
notes: Confident, warm register for a featured quote.

subject: Woman smiling, black top, plain light-grey ground

subject: Young man in a hat, slight smile, plain light ground

subject: Woman in glasses and a plaid shirt smiling in front of a whiteboard

subject: Man in round glasses and a striped tee, chin on hand, smiling, light ground
